text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from hanging out with 
Daitaku Helios, her phone rang yet again.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, from a bestie! Wait, for real, they're 
filming a god-tier UmaTokker?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I gotta go say hi!! There's a chance I 
could get a two-shot photo, right!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Trainy-P, dash to the woods, let's gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's just the nearby forest, even a 
non-Umamusume should manage. Today's the 
day I don't drag them down...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ain't that weird? Can't find it anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I totally passed the place I was 
told about! Did I miss it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just how many hours have we been walking 
along this pathless route...? I've managed 
to keep up this far, but my legs already 
feel like lead...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, another one from my bestie! ...Wha, 
for real about yesterday!? What a 
hilarious misunderstanding~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, crap. The battery died.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly checked my own smartphone, only 
to find its battery was dead too...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Run out of battery too, Trainy-P! Ahahaha, 
that's not like me at all~☆
choice_data_list: A-Anyway, let's head back the way we came!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: K!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: What is this, a cliff!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a pic! ...Wait, my phone won't 
turn on! *Sob*!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A cliff I definitely don't recognize... 
Looks like I took a wrong turn. ...It's a 
rugged path, and I don't have any stamina 
left.
choice_data_list:
(…If I complain, it'll just make her 
anxious.)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: What's up!? Feeling down in the dumps~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're crying 'cause you couldn't meet 
the UmaTokker! So relatable~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Okie-dokie! I'll post it in like two 
seconds! Be right back!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyy☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did they go look for a safe way back? Or 
perhaps they went to call for help...? —A 
glimmer of hope to return home began to 
emerge.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wooohoo~~!! Sorry for the wait, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"First, let's kick things off with a bang☆ 
Hachi-miii, come onnn!"
choice_data_list: Why would you do that to Hachimi!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
They were sellin' it down the mountain! 
Looks super tasty, right? Let's get hyped 
and party on~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Keep hyping it up~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios plugged the music player 
she brought into the speakers. Then, 
booming music echoed through the forest.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah! Aight yeah! Putcha hands up! 
Putcha hands up!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A chill forest is like, totally not the 
vibe~~! Let's get hype, wheeeyyy~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate you trying to cheer me up... 
but right now, I just really need to 
rest...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Dance with me, Trainy-P! Let's party it 
uuup~~~!!
choice_data_list: I need to rest for a bit...
Could you go call someone over?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, giving up already? Okie-dokie! I'mma 
go party over there then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios disappeared deep into the 
thicket. There wasn't a trace of her 
left...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! The old-timers are crazy hype! 
Calling them their 'regular crew' is just 
the best~~?!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text: So we're in trouble, huh? Hahahaha!
choice_data_list: A voice...!? Let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainy! New besties! Old geezers who 
are totally into mountain climbing, yo!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text:
Hello~. Do you two climb this mountain 
trail often as well?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No, it's my first time though! Wait, there 
was a path here? That's hilarious~~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To think there was a mountain trail right 
nearby... I collapsed on the spot from 
relief. —At any rate, we made it down the 
mountain safely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't have the stamina left to make it 
down the mountain on my own. I hate to 
ask, but could you work with Daitaku 
Helios to carry me down...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! Alright, I'll go round up the 
usual crew!
choice_data_list: Huh, that's not what I meant...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pon-popo~~n! And we're good! All the 
hardcore party people gather round and 
waaaay☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Holding a music festival right here is 
totally insane!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Give 'em the usual, Heli~~!! Go get 
'em~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, then follow my lead~~♪ Turn. It. 
Uuuuup~~!! Whooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A festival with Daitaku Helios's friends 
has officially begun... Guess there's 
nothing to do but wait until it's over.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Oho! Trai-pi is asleep! Tired vibes, rest 
up~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I must have drifted off to sleep at some 
point. By the time I woke up, I was being 
carried down the mountain by a whole crowd 
of Umamusume...
